{{Top|leg}}
'''Ball bearing missiles''' were an anti-[[dovin basal]] weapon used in [[Twin Suns Squadron]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It consisted of an open metal tube packed with a plasma-based explosive. The other end was packed with multiple ball bearings, that, when superheated by the detonated charge, could penetrate the dovin basal's defenses.
